purpose: Floor-native and cross-floor practical technical labs using current canonical scenario definitions, with multiple exercises per level and canonical federal-training references where available.

scenarios.title: B1 Core / IDF Power Failure

objectives.description: Inspect the scoped building equipment and diagnose the simulated fault.
Restore the affected sandbox equipment/path.
Validate the scoped system after restoration.

observation.accepted_finding: The active simulated fault is idf_ups_failure.

observation.simulated_change: idf_ups_failure cleared in the sandbox; no live building control is permitted.

observation.validation: Scoped equipment/path returned to the modeled baseline.
